LOCAL_ACTION_ACCEPTED.definition: Fast Sheep locally accepted and recorded the send action for attempted dispatch; this does not establish PDD application acceptance or delivery.

UNKNOWN.definition: A remote side effect may have occurred, but no authoritative result is available. UNKNOWN must not be collapsed into REJECTED or success.

REJECTED.definition: An authoritative platform rejection or failure result is received; no real rejected-send example was exercised in SHEEP-081.
